description: Ministry of Water Supply - Constructions of Nayabedda water Treatment Plant under Nayabedda, Glananor Estate water Treatment Plant under Amunakele, Adisampathana water storage Tank under Amunakele, and Glananor Estate water Storage Tank under Amunakele water Supply Schemes
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific land parcels for water treatment plants and storage tanks. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land properties, including location, boundaries, extent, survey plans, and claimant information. While a government minister is named (Vasudeva Nanayakkara), this is incidental to the core purpose of the document, which is land acquisition for public infrastructure projects. The detailed land descriptions and acquisition focus place this firmly in the Land Gazette category.
